caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with an oval-shaped drop-leaf top. The tabletop is a reddish-brown wood color, and the table has four legs, each with a curved cut-out design at the base. The legs are connected by a central stretcher with a decorative shape. There is a single drawer with a small knob on the right side of the table beneath the tabletop. One drop-leaf panel is shown in the down position, where its curved shape follows the contour of the tabletop. In the bottom left corner, there is a smaller technical drawing showing the table from a top-down view and a side view, including measurements (36" width, 18" depth, 28" height). The table is framed by a large rectangle and the entire composition is drawn in brown, red, and beige tones on off-white paper. At the bottom right, the name "ERNEST TOWERS J.R." and "DEL. 1561" appear.
title: Table
